proposed_widenings.name: moveable_area_dual_effect
proposed_widenings.justification: Conjure Celestial creates a cylinder that (a) can be repositioned up to 30 ft per turn when the caster moves, and (b) applies a caster-chosen effect (heal or damage) to each creature it touches. No existing spell family supports a moveable area with a per-target player-choice between two mechanically distinct effects (heal vs. save-gate damage). The ongoing_effect family has a single operation; activation has no persistent area; neither supports a choose branch.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You conjure a spirit from the Upper Planes, which manifests as a pillar of light in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder centered on a point within range. For each creature you can see in the Cylinder, choose which of these lights shines on it: Healing Light / Searing Light. ... when you move on your turn, you can also move the Cylinder up to 30 feet.

proposed_widenings.name: heal in spell Effect union
proposed_widenings.justification: Spell Effect = DamageEffect | NoneEffect. Healing Light restores HP equal to 4d12 + spellcasting modifier. There is no HealEffect in the spell Effect type (heal_hp exists only in ClassFeatureEffect). This must be added before any area-heal spell can be honestly encoded.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The target regains Hit Points equal to 4d12 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

proposed_widenings.name: cylinder area shape
proposed_widenings.justification: The current Attachment area shape only models sphere (radiusFeet). Conjure Celestial uses a cylinder (10-ft radius, 40-ft high), which is geometrically distinct and cannot be approximated as a sphere without misrepresenting the rule.
proposed_widenings.evidence: a pillar of light in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder

proposed_widenings.name: area_enter_or_end_turn window
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell fires when the cylinder moves into a creature's space, when a creature enters the cylinder, or when a creature ends its turn in the cylinder. post_action_window approximates 'after a creature acts' but does not cleanly express enter-area or end-turn-in-area triggers. A dedicated window variant (or a union of trigger conditions) is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever the Cylinder moves into the space of a creature you can see and whenever a creature you can see enters the Cylinder or ends its turn there, you can bathe it in one of the lights.

proposed_widenings.name: moveable attachment
proposed_widenings.justification: No Attachment shape supports repositioning. The cylinder can be moved up to 30 ft per turn as part of the caster's movement. This is structurally distinct from a static area attachment and requires a new attachment modifier or family.
proposed_widenings.evidence: when you move on your turn, you can also move the Cylinder up to 30 feet

notes: Five distinct gaps prevent honest encoding: (1) no heal variant in spell Effect; (2) no cylinder area shape; (3) no moveable area attachment; (4) no per-target player-choice between two effects within an ongoing spell family; (5) no enter-area/end-turn-in-area window. The core structural gap is (4): the ongoing_effect family has a single operation field, and no spell family supports a choose branch between heal and save-gate damage per creature. The choose atom exists in v4 taxonomy but is not wired into any existing spell family.
